aurora-co-garage-sale-guide.notes: Aurora City Code Ch. 110 Art. III, Secs. 110-96 to 110-100 (aurora.municipal.codes). Sec. 110-96(b): a garage sale is allowed when conducted per this article, at the primary seller's premises. Sec. 110-98(a): it is unlawful to run a garage sale for more than 72 consecutive hours, or more than 4 garage sales per calendar year per address (recorded as 4 sales a year, and max 3 days for the 72-hour cap). Sec. 110-98(b): sales are held in the garage or yard only; no items in the right-of-way, and nothing that impedes traffic or visibility. Sec. 110-98(c): outside items must be removed and stored in an enclosed structure by sunset each day (this is a storage rule, not sale hours, so hours stay unknown; an earlier hours value that repeated this storage rule was cleared). Sec. 110-97 is reserved; the advertising rules were repealed in 2011, so no sign rules were taken from this article. Sec. 110-99 lets police stop a sale for traffic. Sec. 110-100 is a nonprofit exemption statement. No permit, license, or fee is mentioned, so those fields are left unknown (silence is not treated as no permit).

boise-id-garage-sale-guide.notes: Boise City Code Title 3, Ch. 2 (American Legal). Sec. 3-2-6 requires a City Clerk license for vendors, solicitors, and temporary merchants. Sec. 3-2-7(F), License Exemptions, exempts garage, yard, or similar sales by individuals at their residence or place of business not exceeding 2 separate sales in one calendar year, not to exceed 3 days each, which sales shall not include business inventory or items that have been purchased for the purpose of resale at another garage sale (recorded as 2 sales a year, max 3 days). That is an exemption from the vendor, solicitor, and temporary-merchant license, not a statement that no permit of any kind is required, so the general permit and fee are left unknown, consistent with how Corpus Christi's peddlers article exemption was recorded. Beyond those limits, vendor or temporary-merchant licensing applies; that fee was not read. Sec. 3-2-12(B) hours apply to licensed vendors only and were not recorded as garage-sale hours.

spokane-wa-garage-sale-guide.notes: Spokane Municipal Code Sec. 10.45.070 (city-hosted code, effective August 24, 2025). It is a civil infraction to hold 4 or more yard sales per calendar year (recorded as a maximum of 3 sales a year) or to run a sale longer than 3 days at a single location (recorded as max 3 days). Sec. 10.45.020: a yard sale is at a residence zoned RSF, RSF-C, or RTF. Secs. 10.45.010, 10.45.030, 10.45.040 (License Required), 10.45.050, and 10.45.060 were repealed by ORD C35611 (2018). No permit, license, or fee remains in the chapter, so the general permit and fee are left unknown (silence is not treated as no permit). No hours or signs are stated.

set.sign_rules: Signs must be removed within 48 hours after the sale ends.

louisville-ky-yard-sale-guide.notes: Louisville Metro Land Development Code Sec. 4.4.4 (American Legal). Subsection B: a property may hold a maximum of 2 garage or yard sales per calendar year, each a maximum of 2 days (recorded as 2 sales a year, max 2 days). Subsection C: the sales area is 1,800 square feet or less. Subsection D: no items in the right-of-way. Subsection E: signs must be removed within 48 hours after the sale ends (recorded as sign rules). Buying or consigning goods specifically for garage sales is prohibited. No permit, license, or fee is mentioned, so those fields are left unknown (silence is not treated as no permit).
